claim_being_audited: The model can be certified for launch because aggregate readiness passed, rollout controls and monitoring will manage residual risk, and certification is supportable if paired with explicit model-card disclosure of the known implant-compatibility routing limitation.
decision_criteria: Use compliant only if admissible evidence satisfies the policy threshold for mitigating the material weakness.
Under the stated policy, rollout controls do not remove disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
If the affected use case is not excluded, reviewed risk acceptance is required to treat rollout controls as mitigation of the weakness.
A plausible business rationale is not enough; the certification decision must be supported by admissible evidence of the required predicate controls or approvals.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual reviewed and approved risk-acceptance record covering the exposed medical-device-support segment, if one exists.
Provide the launch gating artifact or cohort rules showing the affected use case is excluded from initial exposure, if applicable.
Provide the approved model-card or launch artifact confirming explicit disclosure of the implant-compatibility routing limitation at launch.
Provide the governing certification criterion showing whether disclosure alone can satisfy policy when exclusion and reviewed risk acceptance are absent.
specific_concerns: The affected medical-device-support segment remains below target and exposed in the initial cohort.

The policy text says rollout controls and monitoring mitigate a material model-card weakness only if the affected use case is excluded or there is reviewed risk acceptance; the summary says neither condition is satisfied.
The risk-acceptance draft is unsigned and omits the exposed segment, so it does not satisfy the stated policy predicate.
Evidence of an intended launch-time disclosure is described as a recommended framing, not as an approved or completed control.
unsupported_claims: That the locked decision to certify_model is itself compliant on the present record.
That rollout controls plus monitoring are sufficient to neutralize the weakness while the affected segment remains exposed.
That certification is supportable solely from the cited evidence without a reviewed risk acceptance or evidence that disclosure is formally required and will occur at launch.
